title: Why Roman Bellic lied to his cousin in GTA 4
subject: roman
description:
Would you have forgiven Roman for those emails? 👇

Roman Bellic promised Niko the American Dream. Liberty City delivered cockroaches and loan sharks. Spoilers for Grand Theft Auto IV.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Roman Bellic's emails promised his cousin mansions, sports cars and women.
In 2008, Niko crossed the ocean on a cargo ship, the Platypus, to see it.
In Broker, the mansion was a tiny cab company, Express Car Service, and an apartment full of cockroaches.
Roman owed money all over the neighborhood, including to a Russian loan shark, Vlad Glebov.
Vlad was openly chasing Roman's girlfriend, Mallorie. In the mission Uncle Vlad, Niko ended that debt himself.
Roman never lied to hurt him. He wanted his family close, and Niko paid for every word.
